verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 system documents its own headless, programmatic remote management: a BMC with Redfish and IPMI, remote KVM and remote storage. That supports unattended, automatable operation, but nothing in the evidence shows CI-pipeline integration or headless job orchestration as a capability of the product itself. The NIM and Kubernetes material belongs to separate software products and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented CI/automation workflows for the system, examples of scripted Redfish/IPMI provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automated operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) ... Remote keyboard, video, mouse (KVM) ... Remote storage ... RedFish, IPMI management
